currentAffairsQuestions.topic: One Nation One Election High-Level Committee
currentAffairsQuestions.question_text: Which former President of India chaired the High-Level Committee on Simultaneous Elections (One Nation, One Election) which submitted its report recommending constitutional amendments?
currentAffairsQuestions.explanation: The High-Level Committee on Simultaneous Elections was constituted under the chairmanship of former President Ram Nath Kovind to examine the feasibility of conducting simultaneous Lok Sabha and State Legislative Assembly elections.
currentAffairsQuestions.source_reference: Ministry of Law and Justice Release, March 2024

currentAffairsQuestions.question_text: The Constitution (One Hundred and Sixth Amendment) Act, 2023, widely known as Nari Shakti Vandan Adhiniyam, reserves what percentage of seats for women in the Lok Sabha and State Legislative Assemblies?
currentAffairsQuestions.explanation: The 106th Constitutional Amendment Act provides for one-third (33%) reservation of seats for women in the House of the People (Lok Sabha), Legislative Assemblies of States, and the National Capital Territory of Delhi.
currentAffairsQuestions.source_reference: Act No. 24 of 2023, Ministry of Law and Justice

currentAffairsQuestions.question_text: Under India's G20 Presidency at the New Delhi Summit, which regional organization was admitted as a permanent member of the G20?
currentAffairsQuestions.option_d: South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation (SAARC)
currentAffairsQuestions.explanation: During the 18th G20 Heads of State and Government Summit hosted under India's Presidency in New Delhi in September 2023, the 55-member African Union was formally inducted as a permanent member of the G20.
currentAffairsQuestions.source_reference: Ministry of External Affairs, Government of India

currentAffairsQuestions.question_text: The India-Middle East-Europe Economic Corridor (IMEC) MoU was unveiled on the sidelines of the G20 Summit in New Delhi. Which of the following connects the Eastern Corridor of IMEC?
currentAffairsQuestions.explanation: The IMEC comprises two separate corridors: the East Corridor connecting India to the Arabian Gulf, and the Northern Corridor connecting the Arabian Gulf to Europe, fostering economic integration and clean energy connectivity.
currentAffairsQuestions.source_reference: Partnership for Global Infrastructure and Investment (PGII) & IMEC MoU

currentAffairsQuestions.question_text: India's first dedicated solar observatory mission, Aditya-L1, was successfully placed into a halo orbit around which Lagrange point of the Sun-Earth system?
currentAffairsQuestions.explanation: ISRO launched Aditya-L1 on September 2, 2023, and it was successfully injected into a halo orbit around the Sun-Earth Lagrangian point L1, located about 1.5 million km from Earth, allowing uninterrupted solar viewing.

currentAffairsQuestions.question_text: What is the implementation period approved by the Union Cabinet for India's National Quantum Mission (NQM) to scale quantum computing and communications capabilities?
currentAffairsQuestions.explanation: The Union Cabinet approved the National Quantum Mission (NQM) for the period 2023-24 to 2030-31 with an outlay of Rs. 6003.65 crore, led by the Department of Science and Technology.

currentAffairsQuestions.topic: PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana
currentAffairsQuestions.question_text: Under the PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana launched by the Government of India, how many units of free electricity per month are targeted for up to one crore households through rooftop solar installations?
currentAffairsQuestions.explanation: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana was approved in February 2024 with an outlay of Rs. 75,021 crore to provide up to 300 units of free electricity per month for 1 crore households through rooftop solar systems.
currentAffairsQuestions.source_name: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE)

currentAffairsQuestions.question_text: The PM Vishwakarma scheme, launched in September 2023, provides holistic support, collateral-free credit, and modern tools to traditional artisans and craftspeople across how many traditional trades?
currentAffairsQuestions.explanation: PM Vishwakarma covers 18 traditional trades including carpenters, blacksmiths, goldsmiths, potters, sculptors, cobblers, masons, and tailors across rural and urban India.
currentAffairsQuestions.source_name: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME)

currentAffairsQuestions.question_text: Which iconic European nation officially rolled out India's Unified Payments Interface (UPI) at the Eiffel Tower in Paris, enabling Indian tourists to pay via UPI?
currentAffairsQuestions.explanation: NPCI International Payments Limited (NIPL) launched UPI acceptance in France at the Eiffel Tower in February 2024 in partnership with Lyra Network, making France the first European country to adopt UPI.

currentAffairsQuestions.topic: India-EFTA Trade and Economic Partnership Agreement
currentAffairsQuestions.question_text: India signed a landmark Trade and Economic Partnership Agreement (TEPA) in March 2024 with the European Free Trade Association (EFTA), which includes Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway, and which fourth country?
currentAffairsQuestions.explanation: The European Free Trade Association (EFTA) consists of four non-EU European countries: Switzerland, Norway, Iceland, and Liechtenstein. The agreement entails an investment commitment of $100 billion over 15 years.

currentAffairsQuestions.question_text: In the 19th Asian Games held in Hangzhou, China, how many total medals did India win, crossing the historic 100-medal milestone for the first time in Asian Games history?
currentAffairsQuestions.explanation: India concluded its campaign at the Hangzhou 2022 Asian Games (held in 2023) with a record tally of 107 medals (28 Gold, 38 Silver, and 41 Bronze), achieving its slogan "Iss baar 100 paar".
currentAffairsQuestions.source_reference: Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports Official Records

currentAffairsQuestions.question_text: India won the ICC Men's T20 World Cup 2024 by defeating South Africa in the final played at which historic venue in the West Indies?
currentAffairsQuestions.option_b: Queen's Park Oval, Port of Spain, Trinidad
currentAffairsQuestions.explanation: India won the 2024 ICC Men's T20 World Cup on June 29, 2024, defeating South Africa by 7 runs in the final held at the Kensington Oval in Bridgetown, Barbados, under Rohit Sharma's captaincy.

currentAffairsQuestions.question_text: In 2024, the Bharat Ratna—India's highest civilian award—was conferred upon several eminent personalities. Who among the following was NOT among the 2024 Bharat Ratna awardees?
currentAffairsQuestions.explanation: In 2024, Bharat Ratna was announced for Karpoori Thakur, L.K. Advani, P.V. Narasimha Rao, Charan Singh, and M.S. Swaminathan. Atal Bihari Vajpayee received the Bharat Ratna earlier in 2015.

currentAffairsQuestions.question_text: Veteran actor Mithun Chakraborty was conferred with the prestigious Dadasaheb Phalke Award—India's highest award in cinema—at which National Film Awards ceremony?
currentAffairsQuestions.explanation: Mithun Chakraborty was honored with the Dadasaheb Phalke Lifetime Achievement Award for his iconic contribution to Indian cinema at the 70th National Film Awards in October 2024.

currentAffairsQuestions.topic: Chief Election Commissioner and Election Commissioners
currentAffairsQuestions.question_text: Under the Chief Election Commissioner and other Election Commissioners (Appointment, Conditions of Service and Term of Office) Act, 2023, who chairs the Selection Committee for appointing Election Commissioners?
currentAffairsQuestions.explanation: Under the 2023 Act, the Selection Committee is chaired by the Prime Minister and includes the Leader of Opposition in Lok Sabha (or leader of largest opposition party) and a Union Cabinet Minister nominated by the Prime Minister.
currentAffairsQuestions.source_reference: The Gazette of India, Act No. 49 of 2023

currentAffairsQuestions.question_text: Who was appointed by the Government of India as the Chairman of the Sixteenth Finance Commission constituted in December 2023?
currentAffairsQuestions.explanation: The Government of India constituted the 16th Finance Commission with former NITI Aayog Vice-Chairman Dr. Arvind Panagariya as its Chairman to recommend the distribution of tax revenues between the Union and States for 2026-2031.
currentAffairsQuestions.source_name: Ministry of Finance, Government of India

currentAffairsQuestions.question_text: With three new wetlands added from Tamil Nadu and Madhya Pradesh on World Wetlands Day 2024, India's network of Ramsar Sites increased to what number, the second largest in the world after the UK?
currentAffairsQuestions.explanation: India significantly expanded its designated wetlands of international importance under the Ramsar Convention, crossing 80 to reach 85 Ramsar sites across the country.
currentAffairsQuestions.source_name: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC)
currentAffairsQuestions.source_reference: MoEFCC Press Release, World Wetlands Day

currentAffairsQuestions.question_text: The Union Cabinet approved the establishment of the International Big Cat Alliance (IBCA) with headquarters in India for the conservation of how many big cat species worldwide?
currentAffairsQuestions.explanation: IBCA was approved in February 2024 with a one-time budgetary support of Rs. 150 crore to conserve seven big cats: Tiger, Lion, Leopard, Snow Leopard, Cheetah, Jaguar, and Puma across 96 range countries.

currentAffairsQuestions.question_text: The Government of India declared which date to be celebrated annually as "National Space Day" to commemorate the successful soft landing of Chandrayaan-3 on the lunar south pole?
currentAffairsQuestions.explanation: Prime Minister Narendra Modi announced August 23 as National Space Day to mark the historic landing of the Vikram lander with the Pragyan rover on the Moon's south pole on August 23, 2023.

currentAffairsQuestions.question_text: Constitution Day (Samvidhan Diwas) is celebrated every year in India on November 26. Which milestone anniversary of the adoption of the Constitution of India was marked in 2024?
currentAffairsQuestions.explanation: The Constituent Assembly of India formally adopted the Constitution on November 26, 1949 (coming into effect on January 26, 1950). November 26, 2024 marked the 75th year of its adoption.
currentAffairsQuestions.source_name: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
